attempt2Results.scan: Still complete: false. DYNAMIC_VALUE (Slider.tsx:22) moved from `left`/`width` to the inline custom property `--value`. The 2 slider findings from TSX became 1 CSS finding `.sliderThumb left: var(--value)` (RTL.GEOMETRY.EDGE); `.sliderFill width: var(--value)` was not reported. The `.star + .star` ownerOverride was accepted (owner custom-css) but the finding stayed manual with no candidate and no supported patch. Findings: 7 actionable, unchanged otherwise.
attempt2Results.conclusion: Any dynamic inline style value (including a custom property) marks the scan incomplete, which blocks live Original previews. A compound sibling selector `.star + .star` gets no candidate even with an owner override.
